issues.legal_issue: A constitutional challenge to an amendment included in the Ninth Schedule does not warrant invalidating the amendment on the grounds raised.
material_facts: The amendment was challenged as offending Articles 14, 19 and 31.
The amendment had been included in the Ninth Schedule.
The High Court rejected the challenge on that basis, and the Supreme Court accepted its reasoning.
issues.conclusion: The amendment’s validity was upheld and the challenge was rejected.
issues.legal_principle: The Court accepted the High Court’s conclusion that inclusion of the amendment in the Ninth Schedule defeated the challenge under Articles 14, 19 and 31. No earlier cases are relied on in the supplied judgment.

predicates.constitutional_validity_appeal: A party appealed from a decision on a challenge to the constitutional validity of a law.
predicates.law_in_protected_schedule: The challenged law was included in a constitutional schedule that protects listed laws from the asserted grounds of challenge.
predicates.constitutional_challenge_rejected: The constitutional challenge to the law is rejected.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a constitutional challenge to a law included in a protected schedule, the challenge is rejected.

issues.legal_issue: An amendment forming part of agrarian reform and clarifying the amended legislation is protected from the asserted constitutional challenge.
material_facts: The amendment was challenged as offending Articles 14, 19 and 31.
The High Court treated the amendment as part of a chain of agrarian reform and as clarificatory in nature.
The Supreme Court accepted the High Court’s reasons for upholding the amendment.
issues.conclusion: The amendment’s validity was upheld and the challenge was rejected.
issues.legal_principle: The Court accepted the High Court’s conclusion that the amendment formed part of agrarian reform and was protected by Article 31A(1)(a); it also accepted the characterization of the amendment as clarificatory. No earlier cases are relied on in the supplied judgment.

predicates.constitutional_validity_appeal: A party appealed from a decision on a challenge to the constitutional validity of a law.
predicates.amendment_part_of_agrarian_reform: The challenged amendment formed part of a broader agrarian reform measure.
predicates.amendment_is_clarificatory: The challenged amendment clarified the existing law.
predicates.constitutional_challenge_rejected: The constitutional challenge to the amendment is rejected.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a constitutional challenge to an amendment that forms part of agrarian reform and clarifies existing law, the challenge is rejected.
